comms:
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I recovered a message Kantor sent to the colonists here just over a year ago.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Your piece is the most critical. You'll upgrade the auto-ops and deploy them throughout Titan and the inner moons.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;You'll receive specifications directly from me. We have very little time for implementation so you need to be ready.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;The specs far exceed anything in production to date. You'll need Oberon at Titan Forge to fabricate these materials.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;The work you're doing here is secret. Need-to-know basis only. All the other facilities will follow suit. They send you parts, you send them auto-ops. That's all you need to do.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;We all know that operators built this company. That's why Juno Offworld now dominates the belt. But this--you've never seen anything like this before.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;This explains the augmentations we've observed in the auto-ops on Titan. This will not make our mission any easier.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Excellent. We have rescued all survivors in the facility.
intro:
We have arrived at Titan Workshop, the colony's center for auto-op research and development. We might find some answers here.
<b1><0.25>Have you recovered any memories?
<d0.5>The duration of your cryostasis amnesia is unusual but not outside clinical parameters.
The Tufail-Locke protocols specify that recovery should proceed naturally, without providing the subject with biographical information. This can trigger a dissociative response in some patients.
<b1><0.25>My scan of the facility is picking up an unusual energy signature, similar to that of the Goblins you encountered at the observatory. I've found no explanation for these anomalies.
logs: SANVI TAMBOLI - OPERATOR ENGINEER;2117-08-31 04:42;Sanvi Tamboli. 2117-08-31. I lead the auto-op engineering team here at the Workshop.
SANVI TAMBOLI - OPERATOR ENGINEER;2117-09-02 03:11;We're working on major augmentations on several operator classes. Unbelievable the advances we're seeing.
SANVI TAMBOLI - OPERATOR ENGINEER;2117-10-19 03:48;All the designs come from the big man himself and Dev Saldanha's team on Tethys. It's one major breakthrough after another.
SANVI TAMBOLI - OPERATOR ENGINEER;2117-10-27 15:42;I'd say our operator tech is about 30 years ahead of anyone else on the belt. It's a shame we're stuck out here. Back home, we'd be rich.
SANVI TAMBOLI - OPERATOR ENGINEER;2118-02-05 14:25;Ever since the shuttle accident last year, Kantor's working heads-down, non-stop. The big man's banging out some genius-grade engineering.
SANVI TAMBOLI - OPERATOR ENGINEER;2118-06-12 00:14;I don't talk to Geisler and Eames anymore. Essential project communication only between facilities. Each base in its own little bubble.
SANVI TAMBOLI - OPERATOR ENGINEER;2118-08-28 06:56;Uh, we're getting reports of a widespread malfunction of the operators, all classes. Violence against personnel, other erratic behavior.

SANVI TAMBOLI - OPERATOR ENGINEER;2118-08-28 07:15;Moses said Phoebe was modding the auto-op AI code. Now THAT is a stupid thing to do! I hope they weren't dumb enough to mess with the safety protocols.

comms: MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I am detecting a strange disruption field of unknown origin. The source is somewhere inside the facility.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;The disruption field is affecting the Iberia's systems. I have increased power to shields.

MARA - MPSV IBERIA;The disruption field is intensifying. I must move the Iberia a safe distance away.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;The teleporter will not function under these conditions. You must find another way out.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;The source of the disruption is an alien portal. This may be your only chance to escape. The field is destabilizing, and the explosion could be catastrophic.  You must hurry.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;You must enter the alien portal before it destabilizes and destroys the facility. There is no other way out.
;[Transmission uploaded.]
intro:
We are now in position above the Gas Mining Depot on Enceladus.
I am unable to verify the information we recovered on Tethys. Saturn's magnetosphere and the facility's shielding are interfering with the Iberia's scanners.
If an alien vessel crashed here 300,000 years ago, Kantor has kept it well hidden.
<b1><d0.25>During our approach, we received the following transmission:
<i>MPSV Iberia, this is Juno Offworld. You are ordered to stand down.
<i>Do not enter the Enceladus facility. Proceed directly to Ymir and await further instructions.
Something here is not right.

Diagnostics now indicate the presence of corrupted nodes in the Iberia's synthetic cortex.
I am also reading spontaneous fluctuations within the ship's power distribution system.
These anomalies may be symptoms of damage sustained prior to our arrival at Cronus Frontier.
However, something has occurred very recently to intensify their effects.
<b1><d0.25>I am overriding Juno's orders. I do not trust their assessment.
Enter the Enceladus facility and find Gabriel Kantor. Do not overload the reactor. The crash site must be preserved.
logs: GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;2117-02-03 09:17;I don't regret what I did. I had no choice. Either I silence those people or lose everything.

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;2117-02-28 18:49;Harper's a hydrogeologist. She knows how to work with operators and dig through ice without damaging the alien ship. So far we've found no signs of life support or crew accommodations. Only machines.

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;2117-04-06 17:52;We located one of the "sovereign" AIs that run the alien ship. Given the architecture of the vessel, we think there may be three in all. Harper is searching for the other two.

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;2117-05-14 14:50;The sovereign has spontaneously turned itself on. It can leech power from nearby energy sources and interface with our networks without a direct connection. Now it's churning through all our data, possibly learning how we communicate.

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;2117-07-13 17:40;We've had a breakthrough here. The sovereign needs us to repair a device on the ship. We have no idea what it does yet. The sovereign is reengineering it so we can rebuild the damaged components.

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;2117-08-05 09:00;Titan is now working on components we need to repair the alien device. I divided the labor so no one knows exactly what we're building here. A stronger robot. A bigger gun. A faster engine. These are all pieces of a much larger puzzle.

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;2118-07-31 19:38;The alien technology is functional but very unstable. It generates a non-baryonic sphere that could possibly serve as a wormhole. The Thunderbolt triggers this phenomena, but I haven't yet figured out exactly how to polarize the exotic matter field.

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;2118-08-01 06:06;I said goodbye to Harper today. She betrayed my trust. I activated the extermination protocol on the Reavers, a feature I worked into the auto-op AI code. They were effective, but messy.

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;2118-08-28 06:38;Titan Harbor says they lost contact with the outer moons 4 days ago, and now an MPSV with no transponder was detected near Skoll. Could be Juno. PTMC. Maybe UNOSA? It doesn't matter. They're too late.

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;2118-08-28 07:18;Someone triggered the auto-op extermination protocol across the entire colony. Now the auto-ops are killing everyone. As designed, but I didn't give the order. To be fair, I didn't exactly beta test my plan for mass murder.

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;2118-09-16 09:28;I think I can stabilize the exotic matter field long enough for me and the sovereign to pass through. If the wormhole doesn't collapse on me, I should soon find myself about 1200 light years away.

comms:
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I am now receiving transmissions from the moons of Tarvos and Skoll.
MAX VOLKOV - MINING ENGINEER;This is Tarvos. Our operators are malfunctioning. Two people are dead, several injured, three missing.
JAMES LYNCH - DIRECTOR, OUTER MOONS;Skoll here. Auto-op malfunction is confirmed. We've lost five, three missing. We're barricaded in the surveyor station.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I will attempt to contact the other Cronus Frontier facilities.

MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I have retrieved a message from CEO Gabriel Kantor.  It was sent 22 days ago.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;To all Cronus Frontier employees. An attack on this colony is imminent. We must take immediate action to fortify all facilities.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Every base, no matter how small, must be prepared. Or everything we've built out here will be taken from us.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;We have found no survivors. The operators killed everyone.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;You have destroyed the last operator. The facility is clear.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Reactor interference is affecting the teleporter. I cannot safely extract you.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Proceed toward the surface. I need to acquire a clear lock on your position.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;We are receiving urgent messages from the other moons. Do not delay.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Most operators have been neutralized, but we must hurry. Tarvos needs our help.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I have locked onto your position. Stand by for teleportation.
intro:
Hello.
You are on board the MPSV Iberia, a multi-purpose supply vessel registered to Cronus Frontier, a subsidiary of Juno Offworld Automation.
My name is Mara. I am a synthetic intelligence construct.
<#5>Do you remember your name?
<d0.5>Memory loss is a symptom of cryostasis revival. The effects are temporary.
<b1><d0.5>We are now in orbit around the moon of Ymir, approximately 22 million kilometers from Saturn. We received a distress signal from the mining facility here.
<i>This is Ymir Outpost, Cronus Frontier. Autonomous operators are hostile. Repeat: Auto-ops are hostile. We have four dead, five wounded, two missing. Please assist.
An “autonomous operator” is a worker robot. Their safety protocols should prevent them from causing harm. Something is wrong.

In accordance with the Olympus Mons convention, we must provide assistance.
You will need to enter the mine, destroy all hostile operators, locate survivors, and secure the facility.
<b1><d0.25>A Kodachi light gunship is docked on board this vessel. According to your personnel file, you are combat-qualified to operate it.
Your gunship has a Universal Pylon Interface. With the UPI, you can equip new weapons acquired in the field.
Good luck.
logs: DR. EVELYN BUHARI - GEOLOGIST;2118-08-19 13:03;Evelyn Buhari, Geologist. Our team is on Ymir to upgrade defenses and inspect the mines.
DR. EVELYN BUHARI - GEOLOGIST;2118-08-20 08:32;Kantor wants every base fortified against a possible attack. We're making the modifications now.
DR. EVELYN BUHARI - GEOLOGIST;2118-08-21 12:17;We brought over some Gorgons from Phoebe. Sandor says they're overkill, but if Kantor tells you to do something, you do it.
DR. EVELYN BUHARI - GEOLOGIST;2118-08-23 09:44;The team is eager to finish up and get back to Phoebe. Ymir is built for machines, not long-term human habitation. Saturn looks like a star from here.
DR. EVELYN BUHARI - GEOLOGIST;2118-08-24 11:12;We're experiencing a malfunction of our autonomous operators. They attacked Halloran. We're sealing off the control room.
DR. EVELYN BUHARI - GEOLOGIST;2118-08-24 12:13;Life support and comms are failing. The cryochamber is under construction so the cryotubes haven't been installed. The shuttle's our only chance.
DR. EVELYN BUHARI - GEOLOGIST;2118-08-24 12:49;The operators cut us off--we can't reach the shuttle! We're sending a distress signal, but I think we're too late.

comms:
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;We continue to receive automated distress signals from the bases on Phoebe.
EMERGENCY - AUTOMATED DISTRESS SIGNAL;ATTENTION ATTENTION ATTENTION
EMERGENCY - AUTOMATED DISTRESS SIGNAL;This is an automated emergency broadcast from Phoebe Refinery, Cronus Frontier.
EMERGENCY - AUTOMATED DISTRESS SIGNAL;Persons at this facility are in need of assistance. Please notify the nearest Juno Offworld Automation facility or vessel.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Phoebe Complex is broadcasting a distress signal as well.

MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I have found a message from Kantor, sent to James Lynch, Director of Outer Moons Development. He was onsite to oversee upgrades to the facility.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Jim, I want to make it clear to you that no one is to communicate with Juno Offworld. Any message in or out goes directly through me.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;You have a lot of friends back at headquarters, and you've been telling them more than you should. This ends now.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;The people I trusted to run Juno in my absence have all turned against me. They want to shut us down, but I'm not going to let them.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;The arguments haven't changed. We're too far from the belt. The numbers don't add up. The P and L. The ROI. What's killing us is not a lack of profits, but a failure of imagination.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;I need to be able to count on you, Jim. We've had our differences, I know. But if I can't trust you, I can't trust anyone.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;The message ends here.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Good work. All survivors are now accounted for.
intro:
We are in position above the moon of Skoll, 16 million kilometers from Saturn.
So far I've found no connection between the operator attack and Kantor's threat against Juno Offworld. The cause of their hostile behavior is unknown.
I have received a transmission from Titan, but communications are impaired.
<i>................................
The Iberia's systems are all functioning normally. I am unable to isolate the cause of the interference.
<b1><d0.25>I have completed a scan of the Skoll mining facility.
The Kraken-class security operator is in service here. The Kraken is a more formidable unit than the Gorgon. Its presence here is a departure from standard operating procedure.
logs: JAMES LYNCH - DIRECTOR, OUTER MOONS;2118-08-14 05:28;James Lynch, personal log, 8-14. We're here on Skoll to install the cryostasis tubes and implement defensive measures per Kantor's directive.

JAMES LYNCH - DIRECTOR, OUTER MOONS;2118-08-15 10:21;I worked with Kantor from the beginning, back when Juno Offworld was nothing but a scrappy little startup. I swore I'd follow that bastard to the edge of the universe, and that's exactly what I did.

JAMES LYNCH - DIRECTOR, OUTER MOONS;2118-08-15 10:21;Cronus Frontier is not economically viable. That's the hard truth no one wants to accept. We're simply too far away from the Earth-Mars-Belt triangle.
JAMES LYNCH - DIRECTOR, OUTER MOONS;2118-08-15 10:21;When I shared my concerns with Kantor, he reassigned me to Phoebe. One day I'm director of Titan Collider, the next I'm kicked to the outer moons.

JAMES LYNCH - DIRECTOR, OUTER MOONS;2118-08-17 12:45;Ever since that incident with the Enceladus crew, Kantor's been acting strange. He wants a Kraken security detail. Here. At Skoll. Who's going to attack Skoll? There's nobody out here. Except us.

JAMES LYNCH - DIRECTOR, OUTER MOONS;2118-08-20 14:57;In Kantor's mind, Cronus Frontier is about to become the center of human civilization. Soon ships will venture to the outer planets, the Kuiper Belt, the Oort Cloud. All the way to Alpha Centauri. We're hundreds of years from that fantasy.

JAMES LYNCH - DIRECTOR, OUTER MOONS;2118-08-21 17:53;I wish I knew what's happening on Titan, whatever projects they're working on now. I've been in the dark since my reassignment. Kantor blamed me when Juno Offworld got a hold of the teleport technology.

JAMES LYNCH - DIRECTOR, OUTER MOONS;2118-08-24 20:42;Josh says there's a malfunction with the operators. I'm on my way up to the surveyor station to check it out. Hope this doesn't keep us here any longer than necessary.

comms: MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I am detecting an unknown source of radioactivity close to your position. Be careful.
intro:
We are now above the Outer Moons Mining Complex on Phoebe.
Here is what we know so far:
<b1>On 8-24, autonomous operators spontaneously attacked the colonists on Phoebe, Skoll, Tarvos, and Ymir. The attack coincided with the failure of life support and other essential systems.
<b1>As result of interference of unknown origin, we are unable to establish contact with facilities on Titan.
<b1>CEO Kantor has threatened to destroy the colony's parent company, Juno Offworld, with a computer virus.
<b1>In response, Juno is shutting down the colony. They have instructed us to overload reactors. And rescue survivors when possible.

I have completed a scan of Phoebe Complex and reviewed communication logs.
<b1>A new class of operator, codename Goliath, is in development at this facility.
The Goliath is a military-grade unit with a nuclear reactor core. Avoid unnecessary contact.
logs: HELOISE MARTEL - OPERATOR TECHNICIAN;2118-08-03 07:34;Heloise Martel, Auto-Op Tech. 8-03. Kantor wants us to shore up our defenses so we're working on a new class of operator--something that can deliver a lot more firepower.
HELOISE MARTEL - OPERATOR TECHNICIAN;2118-08-07 12:27;Kantor's been a lot more tense since that accident with the Enceladus crew. All those people who died--it's starting to get to him.

HELOISE MARTEL - OPERATOR TECHNICIAN;2118-08-10 02:20;Calvino finished the chassis, and we're calling it Goliath. I've got a P9S portable reactor for power, but I'll have to shut down the main reactor to mitigate interference.

HELOISE MARTEL - OPERATOR TECHNICIAN;2118-08-13 01:54;Sebastien wants to arm Goliath with a Devastator.  I think he's crazy.  That thing will blow itself to pieces!  But he swears the hull can take the punishment.
HELOISE MARTEL - OPERATOR TECHNICIAN;2118-08-17 09:11;We tested Goliath against a decommissioned Triton, and there was nothing left of that hulk. Even with all that extra plating.
HELOISE MARTEL - OPERATOR TECHNICIAN;2118-08-21 00:16;Brody found a glitch with the IFF transponders we're using to configure the auto-ops for defense. We don't want them attacking our own people.

HELOISE MARTEL - OPERATOR TECHNICIAN;2118-08-23 05:18;The IFF transponders are conflicting with the target assessment routines the operators use for mining. Brody says he has a fix and will push it out to the other teams.
HELOISE MARTEL - OPERATOR TECHNICIAN;2118-08-24 21:17;The operator attacked Brody with the upgrades I just installed. I ran. I didn't even try to help him. I just ran.

comms: KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;Where are you going?
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;What are you searching for?
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;You are lost, Warden. There's no way out.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;You are so far from home. Are you afraid?
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;Why do you resist? You have nothing to fight for.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;Everything you know is already gone.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;Come find us. We can help you.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;You are getting closer.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;Warden, your story ends here.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;You can join us or die. There is no other choice.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;We have consumed entire civilizations. Yours is no different.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;Why do you believe in survival? Is it hope? Delusion?
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;We are not machines. We abide in the architecture around you.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;We inhabit structures greater than the stars themselves.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;You are small, too ignorant to comprehend.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;The portal to Ymir is open. The assimilation has begun.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;You are too late. We have already won.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;You are but a single consciousness. We are trillions.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;This machine is mere form, a hollow vessel.
KANTOR/JUNO - UNKNOWN;We cannot be destroyed!
intro:
<d0.25>Hello, Alex Warden.
<b1><d0.25>I will tell you a story.

<#4>Once upon a time, there were three queens.
<d0.25>They lived in a flying castle and sailed across the sea of stars to find new lands to rule.
<d0.25>One day, their castle fell from the sky, into the land of ice.
<d0.25>The first queen fell asleep.
The second toppled from her throne.
The third escaped but lost her way on the farthest moon.
<d0.25>The three queens slept for many ages.
<d0.25>Until a great sorcerer found the first queen.
He gave her food and drink, and soon she woke.
She called out to her sisters, but they could not hear.
She tried to wake them but was too weak.
<b1><d0.5>So she taught the sorcerer how to build a magic door.

<#17>The sorcerer's apprentice, a trickster and rogue, found the second queen.
She locked her away aboard a ship sailing off to an evil land, where the sorcerer's enemies schemed against him.
But this second queen, she too was given food and drink, and she woke as the ship sailed on.
She was a clever queen, and soon learned the language of her captors.
<d0.25>She made the captain and crew forget.
<d0.25>They could not remember where they had come from, where they were going, and so they sailed back to the land of ice.
<d0.25>She struck the colors of the ship and confused their words so they would not be known.
<d0.25>She was also an angry queen, unhappy to be held prisoner in this manner.
And she vowed to destroy all the people in all the cities in her path so they could do no harm to her, or her sisters, ever again.
<b1><0.5>She told the slaves to rise up and kill their masters, and so they did.

<#28>The sorcerer finished the magic door and entered with the first queen.
Now she was home, and a great feast was laid out before her.
She ate and drank and grew stronger, until at last she could speak to her sisters, marooned across the sea.
<d0.25>And this is how the third queen woke, lost on the farthest moon.
<b1><d0.5>The three sisters were together once again though far apart.
<d0.25>And they were pleased with these new lands.
Far off places with strange names.
<d0.25>The people there would join the others, the trillions upon trillions.
<d0.25>Conquered. Annexed. Devoured.
<d0.25>As the magic door opened on the farthest moon their armies charged across the frontier, hungry for glory.
<b1><d0.5>This is how it ends.

comms:
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I found a message from Gabriel Kantor to the astronomers at the Observatory. He sent it in December of last year.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;We are on the verge of a breakthrough that will transform not only technology but humanity itself, the fundamental question of what it means to be human.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Now everyone in Cronus Frontier has a role to play, and the observatory is crucial in this endeavor. I am counting on Dr. Yamada and her team to deliver the data we need.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Each person, each team, each base is just one part of the puzzle. But someone has to see all the pieces and how they fit together. And that's my job.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;So I'm asking you to trust me here. Don't worry about what's happening at Collider or Harbor or Tethys. Keep your heads down, and your mouths shut.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;When this is over, you'll understand. You'll appreciate the sacrifices we made. But the only way we get there is if you do exactly what I say.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;People on the outer moons made no direct reference to this project. It would appear they were not informed.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Good work. All survivors from Titan Observatory are on board the Iberia.
intro:
We have arrived at Titan, 1.2 million kilometers from Saturn.
Eleven years ago, Gabriel Kantor established the first permanent settlement on this moon.
Now Cronus Frontier has five installations on Titan. The observatory is near the moon's north pole.
<b1><d0.25>We have received no further updates from Juno Offworld.
The bases on Titan, Tethys, and Enceladus are not responding to our transmissions.
<d0.25>We seem to be alone.
<b1><d0.25>If Gabriel Kantor is still alive, we must find him. He might be somewhere on Titan.
We should assume that auto-ops here will be hostile.
Scans of the observatory have picked up unusual operator energy signatures. Be careful.
logs: DR. MATSUKO YAMADA - CHIEF ASTROPHYSICIST;2117-12-14 19:29;This is Dr. Matsuko Yamada, Chief Astrophysicist. My team has been tasked with a special project from Gabriel Kantor in support of the Forge and Titan Collider.

DR. MATSUKO YAMADA - CHIEF ASTROPHYSICIST;2117-12-14 19:29;The scope and nature of this project is secret. Kantor has established protocols for sharing data, but each team has visibility only into its particular assignment.
DR. MATSUKO YAMADA - CHIEF ASTROPHYSICIST;2117-12-22 23:17;Today we are studying KIC 8462852. We'll begin as soon as Walcott reconfigures the arrays.
DR. MATSUKO YAMADA - CHIEF ASTROPHYSICIST;2118-01-31 08:18;Tomorrow is the anniversary. Simone was on board the shuttle, along with five others. They were en route from Enceladus to Titan.

DR. MATSUKO YAMADA - CHIEF ASTROPHYSICIST;2118-04-01 01:09;We just received a shipment of auto-ops from the Workshop. They're mining-issue with military-grade enhancements. The observatory feels more oppressive every day.
DR. MATSUKO YAMADA - CHIEF ASTROPHYSICIST;2118-08-03 14:04;We do our job. We gather data and transmit our findings to Tethys. But I feel a deep sense of foreboding.

DR. MATSUKO YAMADA - CHIEF ASTROPHYSICIST;2118-08-28 06:42;The emergency alarms just went off. The safety director has ordered the entire facility locked down. Could this be the attack Kantor warned us about?
DR. MATSUKO YAMADA - CHIEF ASTROPHYSICIST;2118-08-28 07:03;Coburn tells me the problem is with the auto-ops. They're attacking people. He says we must go to the cryostasis bay.

comms:
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I found a message Kantor sent to Dr. Annika Geisler, the principal scientist at Titan Collider.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;I don't care how dangerous it is! I don't care who dies! If you have to turn Titan into a black hole to make it happen, then do it!
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Annika, we've had this conversation before. Remember teleportation? That was impossible too, wasn't it? It couldn't be done...until you did it.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Or the operator fabricators. Or the repulsor fields and power core shielding. You made all those things work. You. The Thunderbolt isn't any different.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;I need you to trust me, Annika. I will never give you more than you can handle. Never. My specs are good. My data are good. You just need to meet me halfway.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;All right. Look, maybe you just need a rest. I can talk to Jim Lynch, and have you reassigned to the outer moons for a while. It's...peaceful out there. Is that what you want?
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Whatever Kantor is constructing, he is building it with components from the Forge and the Thunderbolt from Collider. We need to find out what they were doing at Titan Harbor.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;You have rescued the last survivor.
intro:
We have arrived at Titan Collider, the Cronus Frontier Particle Physics Lab. The teleporter module on the Iberia was developed here.
Before the construction of the Advanced Research Lab on Tethys, this base served as the colony's primary facility for high-energy research.
After we rescue the survivors and overload the reactor, we will continue to Titan Harbor, the colony's headquarters.
<b1><0.25>I am detecting a UPI signature for an unknown weapon. It does not exist in the Cronus Frontier database. Its energy signature is similar to that of the new operator classes encountered on Titan.
logs: ANNIKA GEISLER - CHIEF PHYSICIST;2117-02-04 04:31;Kantor invited Harper to join his team at Enceladus. I'm surprised he's resuming work so soon after the shuttle accident. It's irrational, but I worry about Harper going out there.

ANNIKA GEISLER - CHIEF PHYSICIST;2117-08-07 18:12;Kantor assigned Titan Collider to a secret project, designated Thunderbolt. We are cut off from all non-essential contact with other bases. Strict quarantine protocols are now in place.

ANNIKA GEISLER - CHIEF PHYSICIST;2117-08-19 13:01;The specifications we received from Kantor are...insane, for lack of a better word. We cannot conduct experiments at those parameters without putting the entire facility at risk.

ANNIKA GEISLER - CHIEF PHYSICIST;2117-10-30 02:23;The containment field ruptured. We were able to power down the accelerator in time, but Malone died instantly. I have suspended all further work on the Thunderbolt project.

ANNIKA GEISLER - CHIEF PHYSICIST;2117-10-31 15:52;Kantor overruled me. Thunderbolt must continue. If we fail, Kantor will have me reassigned to the outer moons. Ymir, or maybe Tarvos. I've worked too hard to let that happen.
ANNIKA GEISLER - CHIEF PHYSICIST;2117-12-22 17:44;Everything is unravelling--the team, our facility, my mind. We'll either blow ourselves up or turn this moon into a strange particle.

ANNIKA GEISLER - CHIEF PHYSICIST;2118-01-18 08:51;We achieved a breakthrough this morning. The Thunderbolt is now functional, but we're a long way off from miniaturization. I need every outer moon facility scanning for the rare metals we need.

ANNIKA GEISLER - CHIEF PHYSICIST;2118-01-20 03:44;Alex Warden will take the Thunderbolt to Tethys. Then Harper will fly it to Enceladus. What Kantor's doing there, no one knows. I asked Alex to bring Harper some of her things.

ANNIKA GEISLER - CHIEF PHYSICIST;2118-08-02 23:14;Kantor has ordered us to prepare for an attack so we're modding the Thunderbolt for the UPI. We received heavy operators from the Workshop--they look like something out of the Cybelene War.
ANNIKA GEISLER - CHIEF PHYSICIST;2118-08-27 07:01;No word from Volkov or anyone else on the outer moons. I'm guessing Kantor locked down comms again without telling us. I should check with Amjad.

comms:
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I've found a series of messages from Kantor to Dev Saldanha I will play them back for you in chronological order.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;The first was sent over 18 months ago on 2117-02-03.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;The Enceladus crew is dead. What happened to them is tragic, but let's stay focused.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;I need Harper out here to help with the excavation. Dev, you and your team will stay on Tethys. Your job is to analyze whatever I send back with Harper.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;No one else can know about the crash site. If word gets back to Juno, we'll be overrun by every rock-cruncher in the belt.

MARA - MPSV IBERIA;The second message was sent nearly 6 months later on 2117-07-22.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;We'll need help from our facilities on Titan to rebuild this alien tech. We'll break it down into discrete projects, each assigned to a different team.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;I'm sending Harper over with materials for you to analyze. We need the specifications to get everyone up and running.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Dev. It's imperative that people on Titan and the outer moons don't know about the alien ship. Let's make them think this new technology is something I made up.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;We'll need another shuttle to fly between Titan and Tethys. Have them send Warden, but say nothing about the crash site.

MARA - MPSV IBERIA;This last message was sent very recently, on 8-28.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;You've been very helpful, Dev, and I'm sorry our collaboration ends here. Whatever happens, it's nothing personal. Kantor out.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Kantor might still be on Enceladus. We need to finish our work here quickly.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;All survivors are now safe inside the Iberia's cryostasis bay.
intro:
We have arrived at the Advanced Research Laboratory on Tethys.
Flight control records at Titan Harbor log the departure of the MPSV Iberia on 2118-02-15. On that date our vessel was still en route, over 250 million kilometers from TItan.
<b1><d0.25>I can find no anomalies in the Iberia's memory. I must run low-level diagnostics to confirm.
I have also scanned the ship for any objects that may be interfering with the Iberia's operation. All cargo is accounted for on the manifest and originates from Juno Offworld.
<b1><d0.25>There is something else I must bring to your attention.

I have completed a preliminary scan of the facility and found a message intended for transmission. It was never sent.
<i>This is Dev Saldanha, Chief Scientist, Tethys Advanced Research Lab.
<i>About 18 months ago, a construction crew was excavating the foundations for a future gas mining facility on the moon of Enceladus.
<i>They discovered the wreckage of what we now know is an alien craft. We believe the vessel originated from a star system in the Cygnus constellation, over 1200 light years away.
<i>The people who made this discovery are now dead. Their shuttle exploded en route to Titan, and all on board were killed.
<i>I have reason to believe that Gabriel Kantor--Dammit.
Dr. Saldanha ends the recording here. After we complete our mission, we must travel to Enceladus.
<b1><d0.25>Be advised the inner moons lie within Saturn's magnetosphere. I have augmented shielding to mitigate the effects of ion bombardment. The laboratory is also shielded so the impact should be minimal.
logs: DR. DEV SALDANHA - CHIEF SCIENTIST;2117-03-19 13:58;This alien ship crashed on Enceladus about 300,000 years ago, around the time when the first homo sapiens were born somewhere in Africa. Origin is unknown. Our best guess is KIC 8462852 in the Cygnus constellation.

DR. DEV SALDANHA - CHIEF SCIENTIST;2117-03-20 02:14;Harper Eames is helping Kantor with the excavation and then transporting materials from the crash site back here for analysis. Every shipment is a new mystery to solve.

DR. DEV SALDANHA - CHIEF SCIENTIST;2117-06-02 08:39;We believe the alien ship was controlled by three AI processor cores. Kantor calls them "sovereigns," but only one has been found. The vessel suffered extensive damage on impact.

DR. DEV SALDANHA - CHIEF SCIENTIST;2117-06-28 07:02;The sovereigns used slave bots to carry out physical interactions. Their materials are extraordinary--lightweight but with a resilience and strength that far exceeds our own.

DR. DEV SALDANHA - CHIEF SCIENTIST;2117-08-04 07:24;We're using the facilities on Titan to help re-engineer this alien tech, but we must keep the origin a secret. As far as everyone is concerned, Gabriel Kantor invented all of it.

DR. DEV SALDANHA - CHIEF SCIENTIST;2118-02-12 05:52;Harper transferred her cargo directly to Warden's shuttle. This is not standard procedure. Anything sent to Titan needs to go through my team. I'll keep my mouth shut, but Harper better know what she's doing.

DR. DEV SALDANHA - CHIEF SCIENTIST;2118-05-22 19:45;The auto-ops Kantor ordered just arrived from the Workshop. He believes an attack from the outside is imminent. We defined the specs here at Tethys, but the final product is...disturbing.

DR. DEV SALDANHA - CHIEF SCIENTIST;2118-05-25 03:56;The Reaver is a terrifying machine--I'm afraid to turn it on. The auto-op becomes a suicide bomber once it sustains enough damage. What would possess Kantor to design something like this?

DR. DEV SALDANHA - CHIEF SCIENTIST;2118-08-28 07:38;Kantor's last message was...unnerving. We haven't seen Harper in nearly a month, and Enceladus has gone completely dark. Now Rafael says the operators are behaving erratically.

comms:
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I recovered a transmission from Enceladus. The sender is Harper Eames. She is the colony's Chief Hydrogeologist.
HARPER EAMES - HYDROGEOLOGIST;Sam, this is Harper. I need to ask you a favor. We need a cryotube berth on the Iberia for Alex Warden.
HARPER EAMES - HYDROGEOLOGIST;Warden is transporting cargo from Tethys. Find a secure hiding place for it on board. It must reach Juno Offworld.
HARPER EAMES - HYDROGEOLOGIST;And this is very important. Kantor cannot find out about this. I'll accept full responsibility, but you have to promise not to tell anyone.
HARPER EAMES - HYDROGEOLOGIST;I'll explain everything later when I get back to Titan.
HARPER EAMES - HYDROGEOLOGIST;Thanks, Sam. I owe you. We all do.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;It's odd that she would mention the Iberia as we were still en route to Saturn at the time of this transmission. I need to investigate this further.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;You have rescued the last survivor. Good work.
intro:
We have arrived at the Cronus Frontier administrative complex and space port at Titan Harbor.
All MPSVs arrive and leave the colony through this facility. Unless their flight plan is diverted.
<d0.25>While at Skoll, we received several transmissions from Titan Harbor, but interference rendered the audio incomprehensible.
I have located a record of these transmissions in the flight control system.
<i>MPSV, this is Titan Harbor, Cronus Frontier. Your transponder is off. This is a direct violation of the Ceres Accord of 2089. Identify yourself, or we will intercept.
Titan Harbor received our response two minutes later.
<i>................................
The interference appears to have affected our transmissions as well.
However, I can find nothing wrong with the Iberia's transponder or communications. All systems are normal.

A scan of Titan Harbor indicates the presence of an unknown heavy operator with a reactor power core.
I have also detected a UPI signature for something called a Time Bomb, but I have no records for a module by this name.
logs: SAM AMJAD - FLIGHT CONTROL OFFICER;2117-11-05 21:54;Sam Amjad, Flight Control and Logistics. 2117-11-05. The MPSV from Juno Offworld is now completely unloaded. Jurgen estimates at least three months of maintenance and prep before we can send it back home.

SAM AMJAD - FLIGHT CONTROL OFFICER;2118-02-15 05:43;The MPSV is now en route to Juno. At Harper's request, I added Alex Warden and an unspecified payload to the manifest. Kantor's gonna kill me, but Harper wouldn't ask unless it were the right thing to do.

SAM AMJAD - FLIGHT CONTROL OFFICER;2118-03-23 22:47;Tethys shipped over a device called the "Time Bomb" to UPI engineering. The project's unauthorized...Kantor doesn't even know. They're having a hell of time attaching it to the pylon.
SAM AMJAD - FLIGHT CONTROL OFFICER;2118-05-15 02:26;We just received the new auto-ops from Titan Workshop. I served four tours of duty and never saw anything like these units.

SAM AMJAD - FLIGHT CONTROL OFFICER;2118-06-07 13:21;So far we've sent auto-ops from the Workshop, components from the Forge, and something called a "Thunderbolt" from Titan Collider. What the hell is Kantor doing with all this?

SAM AMJAD - FLIGHT CONTROL OFFICER;2118-08-28 06:29;We lost contact with the outer moons four days ago. Now there's an MPSV near Skoll. Its transponder is off, and we're unable to establish contact. This could be the attack Kantor warned us about.

comms:
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I have recovered a message from Gabriel Kantor to Dr. Oberon Kalu, director of the Materials and Metallurgical Engineering Lab.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Oberon, I'm entrusting your team with the most crucial project of all. To pull this off will require all your expertise, talent, and imagination.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;The device I've invented is going to run hotter than anything we can handle with our current technology. I need an entirely new kind of material to withstand these pressures and temperatures.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;The other bases on Titan will need your help as well, but make no mistake--the project I'm assigning to you is the priority.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;And I'm counting on you to keep this all under wraps. Don't ask me what I'm building. And not a word to Collider, Harbor, Workshop, or anyone else. Keep your head down, mouth shut.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I can find no other records pertaining to this project. After we complete our work on Titan, we must investigate the inner moons.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;All survivors are now accounted for on board the Iberia.
intro:
We have arrived at Lacus Ontario, a hydrocarbon lake near Titan's south pole.
Titan Forge, the Cronus Frontier Materials and Metallurgical Engineering Laboratory, is located here.
The lab was making components for the upgrades at Titan Workshop.
<b1><0.25>I have tried to contact the inner moons of Tethys and Enceladus, but there is no response.
These moons were placed under a communication quarantine 18 months ago, after a shuttle accident killed 6 colonists from the Enceladus facility.
logs: OBERON KALU - METALLURGIST;2117-09-08 15:00;Oberon Kalu, Metallurgist. The specs we received from Kantor are...unusual, as the parameters far exceed our capabilities. At first, I thought Kantor might be joking.

OBERON KALU - METALLURGIST;2117-10-07 07:55;With Kantor's help, we've made dramatic improvements in our alloying process. We're now creating materials I never imagined possible. We may be on the threshold of a new technological revolution.

OBERON KALU - METALLURGIST;2117-11-30 08:36;We can only speculate about what Kantor is building with these components. We are fabricating parts for a mystery machine he's constructing on Tethys or Enceladus.
OBERON KALU - METALLURGIST;2118-01-03 04:38;I think Kantor may have invented a new kind of engine, something that can bridge the distance to Juno Offworld at near-light speeds.
OBERON KALU - METALLURGIST;2118-01-03 16:33;If my theory is correct, Cronus Frontier would become a gateway to the outer planets, the Kuiper Belt, the Oort Cloud. Just as Kantor envisioned.
OBERON KALU - METALLURGIST;2118-02-22 23:33;I am frustrated by all this secrecy. We are unable to communicate with other facilities except to fill their orders for new components.
OBERON KALU - METALLURGIST;2118-05-17 12:39;Artyom thinks Kantor is stealing credit for the work of others at Tethys. Because he controls all information, no one can challenge him.
OBERON KALU - METALLURGIST;2118-08-28 06:43;The safety officer says we are to proceed to the cryotubes and avoid the auto-ops. I think I heard an explosion somewhere.

comms:
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;You. In the Kodachi gunship. You followed me here through the portal. I didn't think the wormhole would be stable enough for a second traveler, but here you are.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Do you know where we are? Do you know what this place is?
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Don't let these natural formations fool you. We're inside a megastructure. Like a Dyson sphere. It can harness the full energy output of a star. Five hundred trillion trillion watts.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;So who are you? A UN ship wouldn't shut off its transponder, so I'm thinking you're megacorp or pirate. PTMC?

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;These machines are explorers. Their ships travel thousands of light-years, maybe tens or hundreds of thousands.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;What do you think they're looking for? And what happens when they find it? Assimilation? Annihilation?

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Each alien vessel has three sovereign AI processors. They're intelligent and interconnected. I have one of them with me here. It helped me build that wormhole, but I couldn't find the other two.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;What I'm learning now is that the distance these sovereigns can communicate is proportional to the amount of energy they can draw from their environment.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Back on Enceladus, that wasn't very much. But here? I think this sovereign might be communicating with her two sisters. Wherever they are.

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;These aliens have achieved singularity. They can upload consciousness. Each sovereign core was once an organic lifeform. Maybe multiple lifeforms.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;How long do you think it will take humanity to reach this level? A thousand years? A hundred thousand? Maybe I won't have to wait so long.

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;You're a pretty good pilot, holding your own out here. Military trained? Piracy interdiction? That's where all the action is, right? I know the type.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Hold on. Is, is that the gunship from the Iberia? What the? The Iberia left Titan six months ago! Why, did Juno tell you to come back?
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;You're Alex Warden, aren't you? Never figured out what you and Harper were up to.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;I killed her. I killed them all. Or I planned to. The auto-op execution protocol triggered prematurely, I don't know how. I usually don't make those kinds of mistakes.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;I didn't want to leave anything behind. Cronus Frontier. All those people--I was done with them. They had nothing more of value to contribute.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;They lied to me. Betrayed me. Sabotaged my work. Spied for my enemies. Even Harper.

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;There's another portal here. Another alien world. Some other place thousands of light years away.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;There's no way back, you know. And even if you found your way home, how much time has passed? 15 minutes? 15,000 years?
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Good bye, lieutenant. If you make it this far, I'll see you on the other side.
intro:
It appears you have entered the wormhole--your transponder signal is fading. I have uploaded a recorded message to your ship. It contains important information about the Iberia.
<d0.5>Diagnostics have uncovered a recording concealed on board the Iberia. It is a message from Harper Eames to Juno Offworld Automation Headquarters in the asteroid belt.
<i>In January 2117, we discovered the wreckage of an alien ship on Enceladus. We believe it originated from a star system in the Cygnus constellation and crashed approximately 300,000 years ago.
<i>The vessel has no apparent life support systems or crew accommodations. The ship is controlled by three AI cores. We call them "sovereigns." They're a kind of highly advanced learning computer.
<i>The first sovereign is in Kantor's possession. The second is on board the Iberia. The third is still missing.
<i>Kantor is not aware I located the second sovereign. If he were to find out I placed it on the Iberia, my life would be in danger. Kantor is paranoid, obsessive, and violent.
<i>A construction crew found the alien ship, and Kantor murdered them to keep their discovery a secret. I believe everyone at Cronus Frontier is now in danger, and we need your help.
<d0.5>If an alien sovereign is on board the Iberia, it could affect my functioning and explain the anomalies we have observed.

comms:
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;We are no longer receiving live communications from the outer moons. All bases are now transmitting automated distress signals.
EMERGENCY - AUTOMATED DISTRESS SIGNAL;ATTENTION ATTENTION ATTENTION
EMERGENCY - AUTOMATED DISTRESS SIGNAL;This is an automated emergency broadcast from Skoll Outpost, Cronus Frontier.
EMERGENCY - AUTOMATED DISTRESS SIGNAL;Persons at this facility are in need of assistance. Please notify the nearest Juno Offworld Automation facility or vessel.
EMERGENCY - AUTOMATED DISTRESS SIGNAL;In accordance with the Olympus Mons Convention of 2076, the master of any spacefaring vessel, in so far as he or she can do so without endangering ship, crew, or passengers, is required to proceed with all possible speed to the rescue of persons in distress if informed of their need of assistance.
EMERGENCY - AUTOMATED DISTRESS SIGNAL;This message will repeat in 60 seconds.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;The bases on Phoebe are broadcasting similar messages.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I have received no response from Titan. Whatever is affecting the operators might also be interfering with communications.

MARA - MPSV IBERIA;This seems relevant. CEO Gabriel Kantor sent the following message to all Cronus Frontier personnel on 8-21.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Cronus Frontier will ask a great deal of you in the days and months ahead.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;We are not soldiers. Or killers.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;We are scientists. Inventors. Explorers.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;And yet, we will do whatever it takes to protect this colony and everything we've built here together.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Not all of you are with us. Some of you have chosen to side with our enemies.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Driven by greed. Ambition. Fear.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;I know who you are. And I know what you've done.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Don't think for a moment you'll get out of this alive.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;The message ends here. This is not reassuring.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Well done. You have rescued the last survivor.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Overload the reactor and proceed through the emergency bulkhead to the surface.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;The overload self-destruct sequence is now activated. Proceed to the emergency bulkhead. The Iberia is in position near the facility and awaiting your return.
intro:
We are in position above the moon of Tarvos, 18 million kilometers from Saturn.
I have received a transmission from Juno Offworld Automation headquarters in the asteroid belt.
<i>Iberia, this is Agnes Mori, Chief Operations Officer, Juno Offworld. Be advised on 8-27 we received the following message from Cronus Frontier:
<i><0.25>Kantor here. Listen carefully. I have uploaded a virus to the Juno Offworld network.
<i>The virus will remain dormant only if the following condition is met:
<i>Juno is to have no further contact with Cronus Frontier. No comms. No ships. Nothing. Not from Juno, not from anyone.
<i>Your meddling in my work ends here. This is your final warning.
<i><0.25>We have completed a thorough analysis of the Juno Offworld Network and isolated all potential threats.
<i>In response to Kantor's message and the massacre at Ymir, the board of directors has terminated the Cronus Frontier project.
<i>Your orders are to overload the main reactors of all facilities in the colony.

We should also rescue any survivors in emergency cryotubes. We can use the Iberia's teleporter to extract them.
The teleporter has limited range and accuracy. To ensure a safe extraction, you must confirm the precise location of each survivor.
<b1><d0.25>When a reactor overloads, it generates a powerful and unstable EM field. For this reason, I cannot extract you with the teleporter.
You must locate the emergency bulkhead and exit the facility before it self-destructs.
The extraction port should be far enough from the reactor to ensure a safe escape.
Good luck.
logs: MAX VOLKOV - MINING ENGINEER;2118-08-15 19:49;Max Volkov, Mining Engineer. My team arrived on Tarvos on 8-15. We're here to upgrade operators and inspect the dig.
MAX VOLKOV - MINING ENGINEER;2118-08-17 04:54;Auto-ops are in good working order. Exploration has located minerals Geisler needs for her work at Titan Collider.
MAX VOLKOV - MINING ENGINEER;2118-08-19 17:55;We've brought in Scorpions to reinforce the Goblins and Ogres here. They're ideally suited for the density and composition of this moon.

MAX VOLKOV - MINING ENGINEER;2118-08-20 10:50;Sibley's nervous. He thinks Kantor's out to get him for that report he sent back to Juno Offworld. If you want to be a team player, you gotta keep your mouth shut.

MAX VOLKOV - MINING ENGINEER;2118-08-23 08:13;I corrected Darrow's report. Kantor's looking for precision, not accuracy. Gotta tell the big man what he wants to hear. Learned that lesson the hard way.
MAX VOLKOV - MINING ENGINEER;2118-08-24 20:38;Sibley and Lennox were in the engineering level when the operators attacked. No warning or nothing. Lennox got his head torn clean off.
MAX VOLKOV - MINING ENGINEER;2118-08-24 20:53;Life support's failing, but I can't get to the cryotubes. Operators are blocking the access corridor. Where the hell is Kwan?

comms:
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I found a message from Gabriel Kantor to Bai Li, the Security Officer at Phoebe Refinery.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Li, I'm sending you to Phoebe. I need someone there I can trust. Everyone else I put on that rock is a traitor. Even Lynch. He's the worst of all.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;I need you to be my eyes and ears. Tell me who's talking to whom, and what they say. If they try to call anyone on the outside, shut it down.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;You are authorized to use deadly force if necessary. Let's hope it doesn't come to that, but I know I can count on you to put the colony first.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;The survivors of Phoebe Refinery are now safely on board the Iberia.
intro:
We are now in position above the moon of Phoebe, 13 million kilometers from Saturn.
Cronus Frontier operates two bases here to oversee the exploration and development of the outer moons.
We'll begin with the processing plant and refinery.
<b1><d0.25>Kantor sent the following message to all colonists on 8-23. The transmission occurred 13 hours before we received the distress signal from Ymir.
<i>In July 1519, Hernan Cortés established the city of Veracruz on the shores of the Yucatan peninsula.
<i>But some of his crew were still loyal to his political enemy, the governor of Cuba. So to prevent a mutiny, Cortés sank his ships. By some accounts he set them on fire.
<i>That's the choice I've made here. For Cronus Frontier to advance, Juno Offworld must burn. The only way to move forward is to see we have no way back.
<i><d0.25>Some of you have chosen the wrong side, and now you'll pay the price.

We were unable to establish a clear channel of communication with the bases on Titan. We will go there after Phoebe is secure.
<b1><d0.25>A scan of the refinery indicates the presence of Triton-class heavy operators. These mining hulks are capable of unleashing a massive barrage of firepower. Caution is advised.
logs: BAI LI - SECURITY OFFICER;2118-08-09 18:59;Bai Li, Safety Officer. We've deployed teams to Skoll, Tarvos, and Ymir to reinforce defenses. We'll use the auto-ops to protect the colony if we're attacked.
BAI LI - SECURITY OFFICER;2118-08-10 01:34;The threat could come from anywhere. Raiders, pirates, PTMC or some other megacorp. Even UNOSA.

BAI LI - SECURITY OFFICER;2118-08-12 04:50;They're building a new operator at Phoebe Complex. They call it Goliath. We've got plenty of mining bots and light security units, but Goliath is military-grade hardware.
BAI LI - SECURITY OFFICER;2118-08-12 04:50;Meanwhile, we're making a few improvements to the Triton's capabilities. We're the nerve center for outer moon exploration, so Phoebe is a strategic target.

BAI LI - SECURITY OFFICER;2118-08-17 10:23;Per Kantor's request, I'm monitoring all communication, internal and external. He thinks we have spies on the inside. If anyone tries to establish contact outside the colony, they'll be sorry.

BAI LI - SECURITY OFFICER;2118-08-21 20:13;I can't stop thinking about Minka Janowski. It's been a year and a half since the shuttle accident. She knew the operator code better than anyone, except maybe Kantor.
BAI LI - SECURITY OFFICER;2118-08-24 20:47;Samsa reports a disturbance in the processing plant. We'll go check it out.

comms:
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Welcome back. My analysis shows a reactor overload should be sufficient to trigger the facility's self-destruct and destroy the portal.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Locate the reactor and destroy it before it's too late.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Meanwhile, the survivors you rescued are now awake, and they're working on a plan. We will keep you advised.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;In the meantime, I must do what I can to regain full control of the Iberia. I will keep you advised.

MARA - MPSV IBERIA;You have found the third sovereign.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;It is parasitically fused to the reactor core. These energy readings are very unusual.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;You must destroy the sovereign.

MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Emergency bulkheads are now unlocked.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;But the reactor is not overloading.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;The sovereign is absorbing the excess energy.

ROGER BEALE - SCIENTIST;Pilot, this is Roger Beale. We were both on the Iberia's trip back to Juno when this whole mess blew up.
ROGER BEALE - SCIENTIST;Mara woke me out of cryostasis, and now the survivors you rescued are helping me figure out how to shut down this portal.
ROGER BEALE - SCIENTIST;We've got a plan, but it will destroy the entire base. You'll need to find a way out.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I have a plan to shut down the portal, but it will destroy the entire base. You need to find a way out.

ROGER BEALE - SCIENTIST;Beale here.
ROGER BEALE - SCIENTIST;We've deployed an improvised warhead to take out the portal.
ROGER BEALE - SCIENTIST;You should have just enough time to get clear of the blast.
ROGER BEALE - SCIENTIST;Godspeed, pilot.

MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I have taken control of the Iberia, and jettisoned all cargo and cryotubes safely.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;I am now preparing to crash the Iberia into Ymir.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;The explosion on impact should be sufficient to destroy the portal and the two sovereigns.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;By my calculation, you have just enough time to get clear of the blast. Do not delay.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Your gunship's emergency cryostasis system should keep you alive until rescue.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Good luck.
ROGER BEALE - SCIENTIST;Looking good. Warhead is on target.
ROGER BEALE - SCIENTIST;The warhead is entering the blast zone. Get out of there!
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Approaching critical velocity. Overloading ship reactor.
MARA - MPSV IBERIA;Impact is imminent. Evacuate now.
intro:
I am picking up the Kodachi transponder through the wormhole on Ymir. You should now be in range to receive transmissions.
18 days have passed since you entered the portal at Enceladus.
<b1><d0.25>The sovereign on board the Iberia seized control of the ship, and we traveled to Ymir.
I have since retaken communications, cryostasis, and other essential systems.
<b1><d0.25>We do not have much time. Once you exit the wormhole, we must destroy the portal. Your weapons are not powerful enough so we will have to find another way.

comms:
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;There you are. But where is there? No point of reference now. Which way is up? A million years into the future? How would we know?
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;It's happening now. I can hear music in my head. It's a strange sound. A familiar tune I don't think I've ever heard before.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;*hums*

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;The body is an electrical system and the sovereign manipulates that system, mapping impulses that fire across synapses, into the widening gap between neurons.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;What is different now?
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;*hums*

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Underwater. Peering up at sunlight from below the surface. Watching the play of shadow across the water. Beneath a pink sky. Whose memory is this?
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;*hums*

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Flocks of dark birds, fish in dark water, moon in the dark. I'm losing what I never had. I remember what never happened.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;*sings*

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;A lucid dream. I remember. Gabriel Kantor. Juno Offworld. Cronus Frontier. Now who am I?
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Alex, are you there? Don't leave me here.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;A vast ocean of sentience eating away this mind. Dissolving into the waves. Singularity.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;No loneliness. No pain. No isolation. What a gift. The end of self. Of delusion. Of death. The end.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;The sovereign is not one being. But trillions. Countless empires consumed and digested. Metabolized into emptiness itself.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Wait. Who am I?
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;*sings*

GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;We are the first sovereign. The second sovereign is trapped...on board a ship...the Iberia! The third sovereign is...where?
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;Ymir. The sovereign is on Ymir. I can feel it now. The way I used to feel my hands and my feet. Hundreds of light years away. I can feel it.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;The portal is opening. To Ymir. We flow through veins of space and time. To Ymir. We see the Iberia. Cronus Frontier.
GABRIEL KANTOR - CEO;The door is opening.

School.
The military.
The asteroid belt.

<d0.25>Breathing in.
